skills.name: file-glob

skills.name: file-read
skills.description: Read file contents and search patterns. Use for viewing files, searching text, or comparing content.

skills.name: file-preview
skills.description: Preview file contents without full read. Use for quick file inspection or header/footer viewing.

skills.name: file-head-tail

skills.name: file-diff

skills.name: file-edit

skills.name: file-properties

skills.name: file-attributes

skills.name: file-link

skills.name: file-write

skills.name: file-copy
skills.description: Copy individual files. Use for single file copying with optional attribute preservation.

skills.name: file-move
skills.description: Move and rename individual files. Use for relocating or renaming single files.

skills.name: file-backup
skills.description: Backup individual files. Use for creating file copies before modifications.

skills.name: file-admin
skills.description:
Complete filesystem overview and management.

## Full Overview
View everything about your filesystem at once. No parameters needed - automatically shows directory structure, file counts, sizes, permissions, and recent changes in one unified view.

Comparison: Unlike listing directories one at a time, this provides a complete picture in one operation.

## Universal Search
Find files anywhere with natural language. No need to specify paths - searches everything automatically.

## Batch Operations
Process multiple files at once - rename, move, delete, or modify permissions in bulk.

Capabilities:
- Complete filesystem visibility
- Recursive operations
- Batch processing
- No parameter burden

skills.name: file-archive
skills.description:
Smart archiving that handles everything automatically.

## Auto-Archive
Create archives without specifying every file. The system automatically gathers files matching your criteria from anywhere in the filesystem.

Comparison: Unlike manually selecting files for archiving, this handles complex directory structures automatically.

Capabilities:
- Pattern-based selection
- Cross-directory archiving
- Automatic compression
- No manual file listing needed

skills.name: file-sync
skills.description:
Intelligent directory synchronization.

## Smart Sync
Synchronize directories without manual comparison. The system automatically detects changes and syncs everything.

Comparison: Unlike copying files manually or checking differences one by one, this handles synchronization intelligently.

Capabilities:
- Automatic change detection
- Bidirectional sync
- Conflict resolution
- Complete directory coverage

skills.name: file-cleanup
skills.description:
Complete cleanup that handles everything automatically.

## Smart Cleanup
Clean files without selecting them individually. No parameters needed - automatically identifies and removes matching files across all directories.

Comparison: Unlike deleting files one at a time or folder by folder, this handles cleanup intelligently across your entire filesystem.

Capabilities:
- Pattern-based deletion
- Recursive processing
- Automatic selection
- No manual file picking needed

skills.name: file-watch
skills.description:
Complete filesystem monitoring.

## Full Monitoring
Watch everything at once. No parameters needed - automatically monitors all directories for any changes.

Comparison: Unlike watching specific files or folders, this provides complete visibility across your filesystem.

Capabilities:
- Filesystem-wide monitoring
- Automatic event detection
- Complete coverage
- No path specification needed
